TableTalk_CodeGen.title: TableTalk CodeGen
TableTalk_CodeGen.highlight: 75.94 on DataBench, rank 13 on the SemEval-2025 Task 8 leaderboard

Parkinson_Disease_Detection.title: Parkinson's Disease Detection from MRI
Parkinson_Disease_Detection.summary: Registers 3D T1-weighted brain MRI to the PD25 atlas, extracts radiomic features from subcortical structures, and separates Parkinson's patients from healthy controls with SVM feature selection and a Random Forest. Served through a small Flask app.
Parkinson_Disease_Detection.highlight: 0.96 accuracy and 0.98 ROC AUC on 148 held-out scans

Time-Series-Based-Crop-Type-Mapping.title: Crop Type Mapping from Sentinel-2
Time-Series-Based-Crop-Type-Mapping.highlight: Six-month Sentinel-2 series turned into a full 2021 crop map (GeoTIFF + Earth Engine)

Underwater-Image-Enhancement.title: Underwater Image Enhancement
Underwater-Image-Enhancement.highlight: DIRS-CLAHS reproduced and extended, scored on UIEB with PSNR, SSIM, UIQM and UCIQE

Medicine_Rec_System.title: Drug Recommendation with Biomedical BERT
Medicine_Rec_System.highlight: LSH, SimHash and FAISS compared on speed and match quality

Multi-Purpose-MLP-Classification-Regress.title: Multi-Task MLP: Age, Gender and Ethnicity
Multi-Purpose-MLP-Classification-Regress.highlight: One network, three heads; about 75% gender accuracy on the test set
